title: Toward a Gricean Retreat: Probing LLMs for Knowledge Boundaries and Referent Specificity
abstract: arXiv:2608.13484v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When asked about entities outside their knowledge boundary, LLMs routinely fabricate plausible-sounding details rather than backing off to safer, more general claims. We frame this failure through a Gricean lens: a cooperative speaker who is uncertain about a referent retreats up the specificity hierarchy, trading informativeness for truthfulness. We ask whether LLMs have the ingredients to perform this retreat. Using a T-REx-based benchmark that varies entity familiarity and referent specificity, we probe models to answer two questions: (i) do their activations encode whether a referent falls inside the knowledge boundary, and (ii) do they anticipate the specificity of the referent they are about to generate? We find that the answer to both is yes, but the two signals are not reconciled in generation. translated_title: 走向格里森式退避：探究大语言模型的知识边界与指称特定性
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.13484v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：当被问及超出其知识边界实体时，大语言模型通常会编造出看似合理的细节，而非退回到更安全、更笼统的表述。我们通过格里森（Gricean）视角来框定这一失败：一个合作型的说话者在不确定指称对象时，会沿着特定性层级向上退避，以信息量为代价换取真实性。我们探究大语言模型是否具备执行这种退避的要素。利用一个基于T-REx的基准测试，该测试变化实体熟悉度和指称特定性，我们探测模型以回答两个问题：（i）它们的激活状态是否编码了指称对象是否落在知识边界内，（ii）它们是否预见到即将生成的指称对象的特定性。我们发现，这两个问题的答案都是肯定的，但这两个信号在生成过程中并未得到调和。模型在实体未知时仍压倒性地偏好特定指称对象，甚至在提供正确通用表述时也是如此。
tldr: 本文发现大语言模型虽能编码知识边界和指称特定性信号，但在生成时无法整合这些信号，导致其倾向于编造特定细节而非退避到通用表述，违背了格里森合作原则。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that LLMs can encode signals of knowledge boundaries and referent specificity but fail to reconcile them during generation, leading them to fabricate specific details rather than retreating to generic statements, violating the Gricean cooperative principle.
